01 | Privacy Policy

Webpage text snapshot | Retrieved 10 October 2026
Legal
Privacy Policy
Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
Last Updated: March 18, 2026
Quick Navigation
Information We CollectHow We Use Your InformationData SecurityThird-Party ServicesYour RightsCookie
PolicyChildren's PrivacyContact Us
Introduction
Welcome to ExamAI ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to
privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have in relation to
it.
By using ExamAI's services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do
not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our services.
1. Information We Collect
Personal Information
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
Name and email address
Account credentials (encrypted)
Profile information (role, institution, subjects taught)
Payment information (processed securely through third-party providers)
Communication preferences
Educational Content
Exam questions and answers you create or upload
Student submissions and grades
Course materials and syllabi
Files uploaded for AI processing (PDFs, images, documents)
Usage Information
Log data (IP address, browser type, pages visited)
Device information
Usage patterns and feature interactions
Performance and diagnostic data
Cookies and Tracking
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and store certain information. See our
Cookie Policy below for details.

2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information for various purposes:
Provide Services: To deliver, maintain, and improve our AI-powered assessment platform
Process Exams: To generate questions, grade submissions, and provide analytics
Communication: To send you updates, newsletters, and support messages
Payment Processing: To process transactions and manage subscriptions
Personalization: To customize your experience and recommend features
Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our service
Security: To detect, prevent, and address technical issues and fraud
Compliance: To comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms
3. Data Security
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:
Encryption: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest
Access Controls: Role-based access and authentication requirements
Secure Infrastructure: Hosted on secure, SOC 2 compliant servers (Supabase)
Regular Audits: Security assessments and vulnerability testing
Data Backups: Regular automated backups with encryption
Limited Retention: Data is retained only as long as necessary
Important: While we strive to protect your information, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage
is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
4. Third-Party Services
We use trusted third-party services to operate our platform. Your data may be processed by:
Supabase (Database & Authentication)
Stores user accounts, exam data, and application information. Supabase is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR
compliant.
View Supabase Privacy Policy →
Google Gemini via Vertex AI (AI Processing)
Processes educational content for AI-assisted grading, exam generation, content analysis, and transcription. The
following types of data may be sent to Google Gemini for processing:
Exam photos and scanned papers
Student answers and submissions
Course materials and documents (PDFs, text)
Audio recordings and transcriptions
Exam questions and rubrics
Data sent to Google Gemini is processed solely for the features you use. It is not used to train AI models and is handled
in accordance with Google Cloud's enterprise data processing terms.
View Google Cloud Privacy Notice →

Stripe (Payment Processing)
Handles payment processing. We do not store credit card information on our servers.
View Stripe Privacy Policy →
Microsoft Clarity (Analytics)
Provides usage analytics and session recording to help us improve user experience.
View Microsoft Privacy Policy →
5. Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information
Deletion: Request deletion of your account and data
Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
Objection: Object to processing of your personal information
Restriction: Request restriction of processing
Withdrawal: Withdraw consent at any time
To exercise these rights, please contact us at privacy@examai.ai
6. Cookie Policy
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your experience:
Essential Cookies
Required for the website to function properly. These cannot be disabled.
Functional Cookies
Remember your preferences and settings (language, theme, etc.)
Analytics Cookies
Help us understand how visitors interact with our website (Microsoft Clarity)
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect functionality.
7. Children's Privacy
ExamAI is designed for use in educational settings. Students under 13 may use our service only through their school or
with parental consent, as required by COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act).
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without proper authorization. If you believe we
have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us immediately at privacy@examai.ai
8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by:
Posting the new Privacy Policy on this page
Updating the "Last Updated" date
Sending an email notification for material changes
You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes are effective when posted on this
page.

9. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:
Email: privacy@examai.ai
General Support: hello@examai.ai
Contact Form: Visit our Contact Page
GDPR & CCPA Compliance
ExamAI complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act
(CCPA). We are committed to protecting your data rights and privacy. For specific inquiries related to GDPR or CCPA,
please contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@examai.ai

ExamAI Data Policy Framework
This document outlines ExamAI's approach to data handling, privacy, and security. It reflects our current technology
stack and practices, providing transparency for educational institutions evaluating our platform.
Technology Infrastructure
Platform Architecture
ExamAI is built on the following core technologies:
Frontend: React-based web application developed using Lovable, with Tailwind CSS for styling
Backend: Supabase platform, providing PostgreSQL database, authentication, and storage capabilities
AI Services: Integration with OpenAI's API for AI-powered features
Data Storage: Supabase-managed PostgreSQL database hosted on AWS infrastructure
Data Storage & Processing
Our data handling approach includes:
Supabase-managed data storage with industry-standard encryption at rest and in transit
Row-Level Security (RLS) policies that enforce access control at the database level
JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication for secure data access
Regional data storage options in accordance with Supabase's available regions
Data processing primarily within your regional Supabase instance
Data Collection & Usage
Educational Data Categories
ExamAI collects and processes the following types of data:
Account information (name, email, institutional affiliation)
Course and class management data
Exam content created by professors
Student responses and submissions
AI-generated grading data and feedback
Basic usage analytics to improve platform functionality
Data Retention
Our current data retention practices include:
Data is retained in your Supabase instance for as long as your account remains active
Institutions can request data export in standard formats (CSV, JSON)
Data deletion can be performed upon request, in compliance with applicable laws
We can work with institutions to establish custom retention policies that align with their requirements

Security Framework
Security Measures
Our security approach leverages built-in capabilities of our technology stack:
Supabase's PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) for fine-grained access control
JWT-based authentication system through Supabase Auth
TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit
Encryption at rest for database content (provided by Supabase/AWS)
Regular security updates from our technology providers
Role-based access control within the application
Incident Response
In the event of a security incident:
Prompt notification to affected institutions
Transparent communication about the scope and nature of the incident
Collaboration with affected parties to address the issue
Implementation of necessary measures to prevent recurrence
Compliance with applicable breach notification laws
Compliance & Regulations
Regulatory Framework
ExamAI's architecture provides capabilities to help you comply with:
FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) through access controls and data protection
GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) through data access, portability, and deletion options
CCPA/CPRA (California Consumer Privacy Act/California Privacy Rights Act) through transparency and control over
personal information
Institution-specific requirements through customizable data handling processes
Documentation & Agreements
We can provide:
Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) tailored to institutional needs
Documentation of our security practices and technology stack
Information about Supabase and OpenAI's terms of service as they apply to our platform
Custom documentation to address specific compliance concerns
Data Ownership & Rights
Institutional Ownership
Our data ownership model:
Educational institutions retain ownership of their academic content and student data
Exam questions, responses, and analytics remain the property of the institution
ExamAI does not claim ownership of educational content processed through our platform

We do not use institutional data for marketing or other commercial purposes unrelated to providing the service
Clear delineation of data ownership is included in our service agreements
Data Access Rights
Institutions can:
Access their data through the application interface
Request data exports in standard formats
Request data deletion upon contract termination
Manage user permissions within their organizational account
Receive assistance with data migration if needed
AI Usage & Ethics
AI Data Processing
Our AI implementation:
Utilizes OpenAI's API for AI features, including question generation and exam grading
Data sent to OpenAI is subject to their privacy policy and commercial terms
Data submitted to OpenAI is not used to train their models, as per their current commercial terms
We do not retain data in OpenAI systems longer than necessary to provide the service
We can provide details about OpenAI's specific data handling practices upon request
Ethical AI Principles
Our approach to ethical AI:
Transparency about when AI is being used within the platform
Human review options for AI-generated content and grading
Clear indication of AI-generated content
Continuous monitoring of AI outputs for bias and accuracy
Regular updates to AI implementation based on educational best practices
Institutional Collaboration
Customization & Integration
Working with institutions:
Customizable data handling procedures based on institutional requirements
Potential integration with existing Learning Management Systems (LMS)
Adaptation to institution-specific compliance needs
Collaborative approach to implementation and onboarding
Ongoing support for evolving data governance requirements
Implementation Support
Our support includes:
Assistance with initial setup and configuration
Documentation for administrators and end users

Technical consultation for institutional IT teams
Regular updates about platform changes that may affect data handling
Dedicated points of contact for data-related concerns
Technology Providers
Supabase
Our database and authentication provider:
Supabase is built on PostgreSQL and provides database, authentication, and storage services
Infrastructure is hosted on AWS with standard security practices
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit
Offers regional data storage options in various AWS regions
More information: Supabase Security Documentation
OpenAI
Our AI service provider:
OpenAI provides the AI capabilities through their API services
Commercial terms include data handling protections
Data sent to OpenAI is not used to train their models under current commercial terms
OpenAI implements security measures for data in transit and processing
More information: OpenAI Enterprise Privacy
Contact Information
For detailed information or to discuss specific institutional requirements:
Educational Partnerships: hello@examai.ai
Data and Privacy Questions: hello@examai.ai
Technical Information: hello@examai.ai
We're committed to working with educational institutions to ensure that our platform meets their data governance and
compliance requirements, with a focus on protecting student privacy and institutional data.
Last Updated: April 5, 2025
